product.description:
Features:

  • 5.3 cu. ft. capacity meets the needs of today's busy homes
  • This range comes equipped with 5 radiant burners
  • Knob and touch controls are precise and easy to use
  • Range includes storage drawer
  • Features the enameled Easywash™ oven tray that allows you to easily keep your oven clean
  • Built-in Wi-Fi and the SmartHQ™ Management app extends the value of your appliance with proactive oven maintenance tools allowing for tracking, management and control from one simple, intuitive dashboard
  • No preheat air fry
  • No preheat pizza mode
  • Convection cooking allows you to cook and brown foods more evenly
  • Dual element oven produces great results with every bake
  • Fifth element warming zone provides convenient temperature control for foods on the cooktop
  • Covered under a 1 year limited parts and labor manufacturer warranty

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 5.3 Cu. Ft.
  • Back Left Burner Watts: 1,200
  • Back Right Burner Watts: 1,200
  • Front Left Burner Watts: 3,100
  • Front Right Burner Watts: 3,000
  • Convection: Yes
  • Sabbath Mode: Yes
  • Self Cleaning: No
  • Depth: 28-5/8"
  • Height: 37-1/8"
  • Width: 30"
